create_DebugSession: create a DebugSession instance with a tool name and env var to enable debug logging
test_DebugSession_disabled: test DebugSession behaves as a no-op when the debug env var is not set
test_DebugSession_enabled: test DebugSession records tool calls and saves JSON logs when the debug env var is true
test_DebugSession_log_call: test DebugSession.log_call appends tool call entries with timestamps and call data
test_DebugSession_save: test DebugSession.save writes a JSON debug log file with session metadata and tool calls
